_note: What you see: A governing body's yearly self-evaluation: respond anonymously, close, scores per theme and publish.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De jaarlijkse zelfevaluatie van een orgaan: anoniem reageren, afsluiten, scores per thema en publiceren.
Zittingstermijn 30 maart 2026 tot 29 maa: Term of office 30 March 2026 to 29 March 2030 · 31 members
Eens per jaar beoordelen de leden anonie: Once a year the members rate anonymously how well the council works, per theme. After closing, the app calculates the scores; publishing only shows the summary, never the individual answers.
Uw antwoorden zijn anoniem. Ze worden ni: Your answers are anonymous. They are not linked to you; the app only records that you responded.
De raad stuurt op hoofdlijnen en houdt g: The council steers on main lines and supervises the implementation well.
1 is helemaal oneens, 5 is helemaal eens: 1 is strongly disagree, 5 is strongly agree
Wat zou de samenstelling van de raad ste: What would make the council's composition stronger?
Het debat in de raad is open en respectv: The debate in the council is open and respectful.
27 van 31 gereageerd · samenvatting gepu: 27 of 31 responded · summary published on 12 December 2025
Hebben minder dan 5 leden gereageerd, da: If fewer than 5 members responded, the app only shows the total score. The breakdown per theme and the open answers then stay hidden, so nobody can be identified.
